coaching.headline: Every Fangtooth, the Genesis Core and the Primal Fangtooth went to us. The tower trade was the sloppy shit.
coaching.team: We owned the neutral map: all three Fangtooths, the Genesis Core and the Primal Fangtooth were ours, and we lost only one of seven recorded fights. GRIM.exe finished with zero kills and the most deaths in the game. The towers were sloppier. After the first Fangtooth they took two of our outer towers before we took one, and after the Genesis Core the next tower to fall was our inner. We finished three towers to their four and still closed it.

focus.title: Turn the Fangtooth into a tower
focus.action: After we take a Fangtooth or the Genesis Core, call the enemy tower we hit next before anyone peels off to farm or chase. A buff that buys no structure is foreplay with no finish.

30.call: Aurora opened on Iggy & Scorch, Lt. Belica finished Serath and Greystone, and the Primal Fangtooth was ours in the same window. Three for zero, prize taken, game over. That is how to close.

10.8.call: TwinBlast opened on Serath, Lt. Belica dropped GRIM.exe and TwinBlast finished Phase, with nobody lost, in the window of our first Fangtooth. Three kills for none around a major is the standard.

21.4.call: Steel killed GRIM.exe first, Serath answered on Steel, then TwinBlast killed Serath and Grux finished Greystone. We took their outer tower in that window while one of ours fell, so the won fight bought a tower trade, not a clean gain.

27.8.call: The only fight we lost, in midmap, with no major objective falling around it. Aurora killed Serath, but Iggy & Scorch was credited with Lt. Belica and Aurora and Greystone with TwinBlast. Before taking a fight like that, name what winning it buys.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Goldilocks324 ran the hardest carry game in the lobby: the most kills and the most hero damage in the game, plus first blood. TwinBlast killed Serath three times and Phase twice. That is a carry doing carry shit.
Phase killed TwinBlast in both early deaths. Energy Lance roots once the beam has stacked long enough, so when the beam lands on TwinBlast, Rocket Dash out early instead of trading through it.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Xeebs ran a fucking tank-support clinic. Steel mitigated more damage than anyone in the game, had a hand in half our kills, placed more wards than the recorded norm and died once, inside a fight we won.

In the midmap fight we lost, Iggy & Scorch was credited with Lt. Belica and Aurora. Force Shield blocks enemy projectiles, so when the Flame Turrets go down, put the wall between the turret fire and Lt. Belica.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Cuban Noobster did the most objective damage in the game by a mile and cleared the most enemy wards. Aurora also took kills in both late fights, two of them in the only fight we lost.

Serath is immune to crowd control and invulnerable during Heaven's Fury, then reappears on the marked target. When Serath marks Aurora or a nearby ally, hold Hoarfrost for that landing instead of wasting the root on an untouchable target.
59bc2b4e-5cc2-4e4f-9dda-9fae3f686f78: Lt. Belica finished Serath and Greystone in the Primal Fangtooth window, killed Iggy & Scorch twice in the midgame and died only twice. Farm ran above the recorded norm. Tidy, efficient mid work.

Neural Disruptor resets at max rank if the target dies shortly after the blast, and both Eternal minors feed the ultimate. In a won fight, fire it at the lowest target first so the reset can chain a second kill.
dfc1532a-f881-4efe-a48b-df67882e88f7: Grux hit hard: hero damage per minute ran far above the recorded norm, Greystone died to Grux twice, and only Aurora soaked more damage on our team. A bleeding brick wall with a grudge.

Greystone killed Grux all three times, twice before the ten-minute mark. When Greystone enters Stone Forged Soul, step out of the slow before the crash lands instead of swinging at a statue that is healing.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.matchup: Duo was TwinBlast and Steel against carry GRIM.exe and support Phase. GRIM.exe's basic attacks deal magical damage and Energy Shield blocks one incoming ability; Phase links an ally for bonus power, roots with a sustained Energy Lance and blinds with Psychic Flare. We took first blood and the enemy duo died more often before the ten-minute mark. Across the match Greystone was their top damage dealer, with physical damage, and Serath's Heaven's Fury reaches a marked target while immune to crowd control.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.build: Solaris empowers the next basic attack after an ability cast and heals for part of that hit, which pairs with Gunslinger's triple shot after each cast. Tainted Rounds cuts healing on basic-attack hits, and Phase, Serath and Greystone each healed heavily. Vanquisher adds physical penetration and executes heroes at very low health, Imperator makes critical strikes hit harder, and all four items carry critical chance.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.eternal: Weald fires true-damage missiles when TwinBlast damages a hero below a health threshold, Forage adds gold and experience per minion or monster kill, and Wind-Rider grants attack speed after a dash, which Rocket Dash and Pacifier both supply. That suits a carry finishing low targets. Natural Resistance is the draft alternative to Forage if crowd control is the main threat, trading farm income for a low-health cleanse.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.augment: Grenadier adds a Vortex Grenade charge, and Rocket Dash refunds a charge on use. Every grenade is an ability cast, so it feeds Gunslinger's triple shot and Solaris' empowered attack, though Solaris has a short internal cooldown. Spray 'N Pray is the alternative for a stronger Ventilate, trading grenade uptime for ultimate damage that loses accuracy at range. Grenade hits are not recorded.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.crest: Pacifier dashes, empowers the next physical damage instance, hits harder against low-health targets and can be recast after a kill. Vaporize and Ventilate deal physical damage, so the empowered hit has a natural target, and the dash also triggers Wind-Rider. Activations are not recorded.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.improvement: The winning core runs Ashbringer where TwinBlast had Vanquisher. Ashbringer's hits cut non-ultimate cooldowns, meaning more grenades, dashes and Gunslinger shots, at the cost of Vanquisher's penetration and execute. Greystone's passive armor, Phase's Vanguardian and Golem's Gift gave the penetration targets, so Vanquisher is a sound keep here; Ashbringer is the swap when the reachable targets are squishy.

a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.matchup: Steel and TwinBlast faced GRIM.exe and Phase. Phase heals linked allies through Essence Catalyst and was the enemy's listed healer, while GRIM.exe's Displacement Blast in Assault Mode pushes heroes away from the explosion. Across the match Serath's Heaven's Fury dives a marked target while immune to crowd control, Iggy & Scorch's Inferno ends in a knockback, and Serath was the one who killed Steel, inside a fight we won.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.build: Xenia shields an ally standing very close to Steel, Dynamo makes immobilized enemies take more damage, which pays off with Shield Bash and Shield Slam stuns, and Tainted Guard reduces healing and bleeds anyone basic-attacking Steel. GRIM.exe's magical basic attacks and the physical attacks of Serath and Greystone all trigger Tainted Guard. Only Xenia adds magical armor against the enemy's three magical damage dealers.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.eternal: Krix adds maximum health, Regenerative Tissue regenerates health after a stretch without hero damage, and Cannibalism permanently adds health on takedowns, which suits Steel's assist count. Festering Wounds is the draft alternative to Regenerative Tissue: Steel's stuns would cut healing on Phase, Serath and Greystone, trading out-of-combat regeneration for anti-heal.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.augment: Heavy Metal adds magical on-hit damage to Steel's heavy punches and Shield Bash based on total armor. Xenia, Dynamo and Tainted Guard all add armor, so the inventory feeds it. Colossal Crash is the alternative when a longer, wider Shield Slam matters more, giving up the knockup for a knockback.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.crest: Sanctification shields Steel and nearby heroes and grants tenacity while the shield holds, which matters against Phase's root and the slows from Greystone and Serath. It also raises the ward cap to three while reducing minion gold. Activations are not recorded; Steel placed more wards than the recorded norm.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.improvement: Tainted Charm from the winning core cuts healing and slows just by standing near enemy heroes, so it covers Phase's healing without Steel needing to be hit, but it gives up Tainted Guard's armor and some Heavy Metal damage. Steel had the most mitigation in the game and one death, so the current three items are a sound keep; Tainted Charm is the swap if enemy healing starts deciding fights.

a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.matchup: Aurora's jungle opponent was Serath, who slows with Chastise, dives a marked target with Heaven's Fury while immune to crowd control and invulnerable, and gains attack speed and true-damage burns from Heresy, which takedowns can trigger again for free. Serath built Manta Scythe, Sky Splitter and Deathstalker for basic-attack damage and lifesteal. Aurora's kills landed on GRIM.exe and Iggy & Scorch twice each and on Serath once.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.build: Spirit Of Amir adds magical lifesteal in the jungle and magical power outside it, Magnify shreds magical armor with ability hits and adds omnivamp, and Spectral Schematics and Dynamo both reward immobilizing a target. Hoarfrost, Glacial Thorns and Cryoseism give those passives plenty of triggers. Dynamo's physical armor faces Serath and Greystone, but nothing in the inventory adds magical armor against Iggy & Scorch, GRIM.exe and Phase.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.eternal: Lotus grants random small bonuses over time and on takedowns, Flawless heals Aurora and nearby allies once per cast when an ability hits a hero, and Fragrance raises magical damage against nearby heroes. That suits close-range spell fighting. Immaculate is the draft alternative to Fragrance, trading damage for damage reduction while near full health.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.augment: Glacial Thorns makes Glacial Charge leave crystals that damage and root, adding another immobilize for Spectral Schematics, Dynamo and the Frozen Simulacrum cooldown reduction. Hypothermia is the alternative, letting Boreal Sweep shred both armors and slow attack speed, which targets Serath's and Greystone's basic attacks but gives up the extra root.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.crest: Tempest damages up to three nearby heroes each second and heals Aurora for part of it, which fits a brawling jungler. Iggy & Scorch's Tainted Scepter reduces healing on magical damage, so that heal is not guaranteed in every fight. Activations are not recorded.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.improvement: Dynamo is the off-meta slot. If Iggy & Scorch's magic starts ending fights, Unbroken Will is the magical-armor comparison, trading Dynamo's adaptive power, physical armor and immobilize bonus for magical armor and tenacity. With two deaths and the most objective damage in the game, the current build is a sound keep.

59bc2b4e-5cc2-4e4f-9dda-9fae3f686f78.matchup: Lt. Belica's mid opponent was Iggy & Scorch, who zones with Flame Turrets, Oil Spill and Molotov fire and knocks heroes back at the end of Inferno. Iggy & Scorch built Tainted Scepter, Oblivion Crown and Orb Of Growth and runs on mana, so Void Drone's drain and Neural Disruptor's missing-mana damage have a target. Across the match Serath and Iggy & Scorch each killed Lt. Belica once.
59bc2b4e-5cc2-4e4f-9dda-9fae3f686f78.build: Combustion adds bonus area damage on ability hits, Noxia marks a hero on ability damage and pays bonus maximum-health damage when a separate ability follows, Wraith Leggings adds magical penetration and more ability damage on heroes below a health threshold, and Oblivion Crown raises total magical power. Seismic Assault into Void Bomb or Neural Disruptor is the natural Noxia sequence.
59bc2b4e-5cc2-4e4f-9dda-9fae3f686f78.eternal: Vesh adds damage over time to ability damage on heroes. The Tenth Seal adds ultimate damage and ultimate ability haste from level ten, and Millennia raises ultimate damage as the game goes on, so both minors lean on Neural Disruptor. Tithe of Death is the draft alternative to The Tenth Seal, trading ultimate uptime for mana and stacking ability haste on takedowns.
59bc2b4e-5cc2-4e4f-9dda-9fae3f686f78.augment: Combat Veteran adds movement speed and a trickle of passive experience that grows with level, which helps reach maxed abilities and Innovation upgrades sooner. Devastating Bombs is the alternative when targets are often alone, adding Void Bomb damage against isolated heroes at the cost of the experience and speed.
59bc2b4e-5cc2-4e4f-9dda-9fae3f686f78.crest: Epoch puts Lt. Belica in stasis, waiting out incoming damage while teammates react. It provides no escape distance, so the stasis buys time against Serath's dive or Inferno while Lt. Belica stays in place. Activations are not recorded.
59bc2b4e-5cc2-4e4f-9dda-9fae3f686f78.improvement: This is the winning core plus Oblivion Crown, and no build change is proven here. Phase's Vanguardian gives Phase and nearby allies magical armor, so if spells start bouncing off the front line, Magnify's magical armor shred is the comparison for a later slot, trading raw power for penetration over repeated hits. Otherwise a sound keep.

dfc1532a-f881-4efe-a48b-df67882e88f7.matchup: Grux's lane opponent was Greystone, whose Stoicism deflects a basic attack every few seconds and grows regeneration and physical armor as health drops. Make Way shreds physical armor, and Stone Forged Soul heals in stasis, slows nearby enemies and then crashes down. Greystone built Overlord, Augmentation, Basilisk and Salvation, was the enemy's top damage dealer, and killed Grux all three times; Grux killed Greystone twice.
dfc1532a-f881-4efe-a48b-df67882e88f7.build: Sky Splitter adds current-health damage on basic attacks, and Double Pain applies on-hit effects twice. Rapture adds close-range on-hit damage and omnivamp, Basilisk shreds physical armor on hero damage, which matters against Stoicism's armor, and Terminus adds critical chance and lifesteal while turning excess healing into a shield. None of the four items adds physical or magical armor.
dfc1532a-f881-4efe-a48b-df67882e88f7.eternal: Marrow heals from damage dealt to heroes, more at low health, Leech cuts the base health regeneration of nearby enemy heroes, and Jealousy adds damage as Grux's health falls. That rewards staying in long brawls. Taste of Iron is the draft alternative to Leech, since Bloodlust's bleed is a damage over time effect, trading the regeneration cut for a damage boost.
dfc1532a-f881-4efe-a48b-df67882e88f7.augment: Red Mist grants attack speed for each enemy hero or camp leader carrying Bloodlust nearby, which pays off in team brawls where several heroes are bleeding. Lust For Blood is the alternative for sustain, healing off targets at maximum Bloodlust stacks while giving up the attack speed.
dfc1532a-f881-4efe-a48b-df67882e88f7.crest: Razorback raises both armors briefly and reflects part of the damage taken from heroes, so it answers Greystone's physical damage in an extended trade. Activations are not recorded.
dfc1532a-f881-4efe-a48b-df67882e88f7.improvement: The winning core's third item is Augmentation, where Grux had Terminus: Augmentation trades Terminus' critical chance and lifesteal shield for health, ability haste and an empowered attack after each cast. Greystone killed Grux three times with physical damage while Grux carried no armor item, so a physical-armor slot such as Stonewall is the comparison if that lane keeps going badly, trading damage for survival.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~0.5s of lockdown): Iggy & Scorch Inferno (knockback). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Phase. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 2 items of it.
Dive threat on our backline: Serath. Assign peel for the carry and ward the flanks.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s), Grux Crush (knockup 0.5s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Steel) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Seismic Assault knockup → Void Bomb → Neural Disruptor silence ult, Void Drone mana drain
ourKits.winCondition: knock up + silence a target and burst with missing-HP scaling
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Seismic Assault; she's immobile — dive when ult is down

ourKits.combo: Vortex Grenade → Vaporize pierce → Rocket Dash reposition → Ventilate ult
ourKits.winCondition: reposition with Rocket Dash and unload Ventilate from safety
ourKits.passive: abilities grant AS + a triple-shot next basic
ourKits.playWith: a frontline to create his free-fire window
ourKits.playAgainst: he's mobile but squishy — CC through the dash, then burst

ourKits.combo: Smash 'n Grab pull → Crush knockup → Warlord's Challenge stun → bleed-stacked basics
ourKits.winCondition: land the pull→knockup chain to lock a target while bleed and AS shred them
ourKits.passive: basics stack a bleed for sustained damage
ourKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his knockup/stun window
ourKits.playAgainst: telegraphed engage — bait Crush/Pull, then punish; kite his slow start

ourKits.combo: Boreal Sweep slow → Hoarfrost root → Glacial Charge engage → Cryoseism stun ult
ourKits.winCondition: chain frost CC (slow→root→stun) to lock the fight down
ourKits.playWith: burst that converts her long CC chain into kills
ourKits.playAgainst: she's a CC battery — cleanse/QSS the Cryoseism stun; spread to avoid the chain

ourKits.combo: Bull Rush knockback → Force Shield wall → Shield Slam knockup+stun ult, Shield Bash %hp
ourKits.winCondition: peel the carry with walls/knockups or engage with Shield Slam
ourKits.playWith: a carry he can wall for and peel
ourKits.playAgainst: his Force Shield blocks projectiles — reposition around it; bait Shield Slam

enemyKits.combo: Ascend dive → Heaven's Fury multi-strike → Chastise slow → Heresy form ult, resets on takedowns
enemyKits.winCondition: dive the backline and snowball Heresy resets
enemyKits.playWith: a frontline that creates her dive angle
enemyKits.playAgainst: peel the backline — deny the first kill and her resets dry up

enemyKits.combo: Telekinetic Link an ally → Psychic Flare blind → Energy Lance → Hyperflux buff ult
enemyKits.winCondition: buff a hyper-carry through the Link and Hyperflux for a teamfight
enemyKits.passive: abilities heal her and her linked ally
enemyKits.playWith: the strongest carry to Link and supercharge
enemyKits.playAgainst: kill the linked carry, not Phase; break the link timing

enemyKits.combo: Energy Shield block → Displacement Blast → Assault Mode → GTFO lockon ult
enemyKits.winCondition: out-trade with Pulsefire and the spell-shield, finish with GTFO
enemyKits.playWith: peel so he can free-cast in Assault Mode
enemyKits.playAgainst: bait Energy Shield, then commit; dodge GTFO's slow channel

enemyKits.combo: Oil Spill → Molotov ignite → Flame Turret → Inferno knockback ult
enemyKits.winCondition: layer fire zones on a choke/objective and burn the team
enemyKits.playWith: CC that holds enemies in his fire
enemyKits.playAgainst: don't fight in his zones — flank; kill the turret, dive him

enemyKits.combo: Assault The Gates leap → Make Way armor shred → Sacred Oath empowered basic → Stone Forged Soul stasis ult
enemyKits.winCondition: front-line aggressively and reset the fight with the stasis heal
enemyKits.playWith: a team that fights while he soaks and stasis-resets
enemyKits.playAgainst: don't waste burst into his stasis — wait it out; anti-heal cuts the ult heal
